scope: Read prototype.py, report.json, ASSESSMENT.md, overlap audit and closest tube-dispersion AUTHOR. Checked source/report and archive-reference hashes. Read the primary paper equations 6-14 and discussion. No new numerical or model runs and no source edits.
findings: Uniform transverse injection at axial position zero in an unbounded circular tube, isotropic diffusion and irreversible Robin wall capture uniquely define both asymptotic loss and accumulated displacement conditioned on survival through the full observation interval. Independent axial Brownian noise changes variance but not the measured drift.
The circular ground mode J0(q r/R) obeys q J1(q)=(capture R/D) J0(q); loss D q^2/R^2 and regular reflecting branch q=0 are correct. Radial integrals use area measure proportional to r dr.

The endpoint-survivor density is proportional to phi. Interior occupation along trajectories conditioned to survive a long interval has the left-times-right principal mode, phi^2 for this self-adjoint radial operator. The source therefore uses an exact positive endpoint ensemble for the wrong accumulated observable; it is a physical conditioning approximation rather than a broken eigenproblem.

The independent conservative annular generator uses cell areas, positive face diffusion and the correct half-cell Robin resistance. Its symmetric similarity transform and principal derivative of L+s*u+D*s^2 have the right signs and normalization. The reference does not insert the analytic squared-mode drift.

The separate zeroth/first axial moment propagation uses the uniform injection, correct velocity coupling and conditional survival normalization. Removing the common principal decay is algebraically harmless. Saved interval slopes establish the asymptotic drift; no finite-time zero-intercept claim is needed.

At fixed physical capture coefficient, the Rayleigh quotient has derivative d(loss)/dD=integral(|grad phi|^2)/integral(phi^2)>0 for positive capture. Thus nonzero-capture loss calibration identifies D. Plug-flow and reflecting Poiseuille means are exact shared anchors but do not independently identify D.

The proposed public preparation and accumulated-displacement readout are sufficient without displaying conditional occupation weights. A final package should retain these operational facts and standard unrestricted implementation permission.
evidence_qualification: Owner-generated prototype checks were inspected, not rerun. Full fixed-sigma calibration, repeated-noise checks, final grading and local verifier controls remain future package work. No model difficulty claim or evaluation approval is implied.
overlap: Closest archived tube-dispersion predicts variance under reflecting walls using mean-flow closure. This proposal retains the exact absorbing radial mode and tests survival-conditioned mean displacement. Gated capture and fixed trap memory share broad transport/conditioning themes but use different physical mechanisms. It is not an exact renamed predecessor.

primary_source.scope: Biswas and Sen equations 6-14 explicitly derive surviving-path weighting and distinguish it from endpoint velocity. Their displayed example is planar; the prototype circular Robin formulas and annular discretization were separately reviewed.
